nodes.label: Architecture: What-to-Ensure vs How-to-Install
nodes.rationale: The code separates 'what to ensure' (checks/*.sh) from 'how to install it per-platform' (os/*.sh). This separation allows platform-agnostic dependency checks to delegate to platform-specific install hooks, keeping the logic modular.

nodes.label: Platform Contract: install_*_os Functions
nodes.rationale: checks/*.sh may only call install_*_os functions that every platform module defines (or guards with declare -F). Adding a new per-platform step requires adding the function to all three os/*.sh files or guarding the call site, to avoid breaking a platform.

nodes.label: Local Execution Mode
nodes.rationale: When $SCRIPT_DIR/utils.sh exists next to the script, modules are sourced from disk. This is the default when running bash install.sh in the repo.

nodes.label: Bootstrap Execution Mode
nodes.rationale: When piped via curl | bash, BASH_SOURCE is not a real file, so the script downloads module files from ALGOINSTALL_BASE_URL into a mktemp dir. New module files must be added to the files=(...) array in bootstrap_modules_if_needed or curl | bash users will not get them.

nodes.label: Python Fallback Chain
nodes.rationale: ensure_python tries: (1) distro package via install_python_os, (2) uv installing Python 3.14 via install_python_with_uv_os, (3) building Python 3.14.5 from source via install_python_from_source_os. MIN_PYTHON_VERSION is 3.12 but fallbacks target 3.14 — this asymmetry is intentional.

nodes.label: AlgoKit Install and Verify
nodes.rationale: install_algokit prefers pipx install --python $PYTHON_BIN and falls back to uv tool install. verify_algokit locates the algokit binary and symlinks it into a writable PATH dir or /usr/local/bin if not already on the user's original PATH.

nodes.label: Dry-Run Verification Pattern
nodes.rationale: --dry-run is the main verification tool. It routes every state-changing command through run_cmd, which prints [dry-run] instead of executing. All install logic must use run_cmd/run_with_sudo for dry-run accuracy.

nodes.label: Coding Conventions
nodes.rationale: set -euo pipefail is on; use ${VAR:-} defaults. All user-facing output through utils.sh logging helpers. Linux supports apt/dnf/yum/pacman/zypper/apk via install_packages_os dispatch. Keep scripts POSIX-portable Bash and readable.

nodes.label: Security Notes
nodes.rationale: Script is plain Bash and intentionally readable. Users should review install.sh and helper modules before piping to Bash. --dry-run before production. Checksums can be published for tagged releases.

nodes.label: Why AlgoInstall Exists
nodes.rationale: AlgoKit onboarding should be immediate. Setup should not be a separate project. AlgoInstall turns dependency setup into a single, idempotent command.
